Here's how to fill in Form 22 from what you've told me. Items 1, 3, 7, 8, 9, 12 (the by-laws question) and 15 are for the property manager or owner. Leave those parts blank unless they ask you to fill them in.

1 Property manager/owner details
[B01] Leave blank. The property manager or owner fills this in.

2 Address of the premises
[B02] NEEDS-YOU: the street address and postcode of the Brisbane flat you're applying for. It's usually on the listing, or the agent can give it to you.

3 Ways to submit your application
[B03] Leave blank. The property manager fills this in.

4 Number of occupants
[B04] Total number of occupants: 1
[B05] Number of occupants under 18 years of age: 0

5 Applicant details
[B06] Full name: Ms GIVEN_P1 MIDDLE_P1 SURNAME_P1
[B07] Date of birth: DATE_P1
  This is your date of birth as it appears in your passport. Queensland forms usually write dates as day/month/year (for example 05/09/1990). If your passport prints it another way, such as "05 SEP 1990", you can rewrite it by hand as DD/MM/YYYY. Either way, the date must stay the same.
[B08] Current address: ADDRESS_P1
  Postcode: Your Singapore flat's postal code is the 6-digit number at the end of your address. Copy it into the Postcode box by hand. If you'd rather it didn't appear twice, you can also cross it out of the address line.
[B09] Phone: PHONE_P1
  Agents in Australia will be calling from overseas, so check that the number includes the country code (+65 for a Singapore mobile). If it doesn't, add it by hand.
[B10] Email: NEEDS-YOU (your email address)

6 Employment details
Your nursing job in Brisbane starts on 1 February 2027. You can list it here and explain that it hasn't started yet. Agents usually accept that when you include the offer letter or contract (see item 7).
[B11] Current employer: NEEDS-YOU (the name of the Brisbane hospital or health service that hired you). If you're still working in Singapore and want to show your current job as well, add that employer's name and write "new role commencing 1 February 2027" next to the Brisbane employer.
[B12] Job title: NEEDS-YOU (copy the exact title from your offer letter, for example "Registered Nurse")
[B13] Length of employment: Commencing 1 February 2027
  Gross weekly income: NEEDS-YOU (your salary before tax. If your contract gives an annual figure, divide it by 52)
[B14] Employer name / phone / email: NEEDS-YOU (the contact person at the new employer, usually the hiring manager or HR contact named on your offer letter)

7 Financial information
[B15] The property manager lists the documents they want. Because your job hasn't started yet, it's worth sending:
- your signed employment contract or offer letter showing your start date and salary
- recent bank statements or proof of savings (without transaction details), to show you can pay rent until your first pay arrives
- recent payslips from your current job, if you have one

8 Verification of identity
[B16] The property manager lists what they need. You can offer your Philippine passport (valid until 13 March 2032). They may also ask for your Australian visa grant notice. Hand the copies over directly. You don't need to write your passport number on this form.

9 Applicant suitability
[B17] The property manager lists what they need. A rental ledger or reference letter from your Singapore landlord would help here.

10 Rental history
Property 1
[B18] Current/previous address: ADDRESS_P1
  Postcode: copy in your Singapore postal code by hand, as in B08.
  (This assumes the Singapore flat you've rented since June 2021 is your home address above. If it isn't, write NEEDS-YOU here and fill in the flat's address yourself.)
[B19] Rental period (Start – End): June 2021 – present
[B20] Property manager/owner name, email and phone: NEEDS-YOU (your Singapore landlord or agent's name, email, and phone with the +65 country code)

Property 2
[B21] Optional. If you rented somewhere before June 2021, add that address, the rental period and that landlord's contact details (NEEDS-YOU). If you didn't, leave it blank. Almost five and a half years at one address is a strong rental history on its own.

[B22] Leave blank. You do have a rental history.

11 References
[B23] Referee 1: NEEDS-YOU (name, phone, email and how you know them)
[B24] Referee 2: NEEDS-YOU (name, phone, email and how you know them)
  The form asks for people who can vouch for how you look after a home. Good options are your current Singapore landlord or agent, a past landlord, or a current or previous nursing supervisor. Make sure their phone numbers include the country code.

12 Pet details
[B25] Leave blank. The property manager answers this.
[B26] Do you intend to keep pets at the premises? No
[B27] Leave blank.

What you still need to supply: the Brisbane property address, your email, your new employer's name and contact, your job title and weekly income, your Singapore landlord's contact details, and two referees. You don't need your place of birth or your passport's number, issue date or issuing authority anywhere on this form.
